name: email-verification-api
description: Verify Email Verification Protocol EVT+KB tokens

scripts.clean:test: node --eval "import('node:fs').then(({ rmSync }) => rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.test:e2e:gmail:harness: npm run build && npm run typecheck:e2e:gmail && playwright test verifier-server.spec.ts --config e2e/gmail/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:gmail: npm run build && npm run typecheck:e2e:gmail && playwright test gmail.spec.ts --config e2e/gmail/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
